chunks: My father narrated (may God be pleased with him) who said: Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim narrated from his father, from Ali ibn Mae'bad, from Abdullah ibn al-Qasim, from Abdullah ibn Sin'an, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: The first thing that causes disobedience to God, the Exalted and Most High, is six qualities: love of the world, love of leadership, love of food, love of women, love of sleep, and love of comfort.
ai.seo_question: What are the six things that cause sins in the presence of God according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Al-Khisal*, Shaykh al-Saduq attributes this chain of six loves to the Prophet Muhammad, linking them to the primordial disobedience of Adam, which underscores their foundational role in human spiritual decline. This narration highlights how natural desires, when elevated to idols, become the primary drivers of sin, a concept deeply resonant in Shia ethical theology regarding the purification of the heart (tazkiyah).
